provenance_note: Frozen executable and source hashes identify compiled code. The row harness emits runtime git/hostname metadata, which describes its execution checkout rather than compiled source. Those three fields are removed from the normalized public receipts; untouched raw output remains local.
aggregation: Median of two independent process observations per arm/ordinary-row rung; median of process medians for 15 warm blob reads per arm/process/size.

scope.rows: Fresh subscription rehydration and one-row maintained delta on separate RocksDB WalNoSync fixtures; 2 or 20 text columns, all small inline values. Retained heap is a model, not RSS. No browser, network, or app startup.
scope.blob: Fresh peer coverage between resident independent MemoryStorage databases with 32 tables, 36 background subscriptions and an account/folder reference. No browser/IDB/transport encoding/app startup.

control.harness_repair: The original update_counts returned constant zero adds/removes; now read supporting_rows deltas without changing its assertions.
